interpretations: Select patients in `Patient` with at least one `Laboratory` record where both `U-PRO` and `RA` are `'-'`; group by patient ID and sex, average nonmissing `ALP` and `HCT` over all their lab records without rounding, then return the 10 highest average `HCT` values with missing averages last.

Select patients in `Patient` who have a `U-PRO` result of `'-'` and an `RA` result of `'-'` on any lab records, even if the results are on different dates; group by patient ID and sex, average nonmissing `ALP` and `HCT` over all their lab records without rounding, then return the 10 highest average `HCT` values with missing averages last.

Select patients in `Patient` for whom every lab record reports both `U-PRO` and `RA` as `'-'`; group by patient ID and sex, average nonmissing `ALP` and `HCT` over all their lab records without rounding, then return the 10 highest average `HCT` values with missing averages last.

Select patients in `Patient` who have at least one `U-PRO` result of `'-'` and at least one `RA` result of `'-'`, possibly on different dates, and no other nonmissing result for either test; group by patient ID and sex, average nonmissing `ALP` and `HCT` across all their lab records without rounding, then return the top 10 by average `HCT`, with missing averages last.
queries:
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP,
    AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS qualifying
    WHERE qualifying.ID = p.ID
      AND qualifying.`U-PRO` = '-'
      AND qualifying.RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_HCT IS NULL, avg_HCT DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN l.`U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN l.RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
ORDER BY avg_HCT IS NULL, avg_HCT DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP,
    AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS x
    WHERE x.ID = p.ID
      AND (x.`U-PRO` IS NOT '-' OR x.RA IS NOT '-')
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_HCT IS NULL, avg_HCT DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(NULLIF(l.ALP, '')) AS avg_ALP,
    AVG(NULLIF(l.HCT, '')) AS avg_HCT
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(l."U-PRO", '')) = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(l.RA, '')) = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(l."U-PRO", '')) NOT IN ('', '-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(l.RA, '')) NOT IN ('', '-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY avg_HCT DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
